# 1 Quillwing

*Medium beast, unaligned*

## Actions

***Multiattack.*** It rakes and shrieks in one go.

***Rake.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +4 to hit. *Hit:* 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

***Shriek.*** A harsh cry that forces a DC 13 Constitution saving throw.
